name: Redwood Prison
desc:
Welcome to Redwood Correctional Facility.

I put out an update that should stop everything from going green!

New in servers Version 1.428:
- Added Four-Wheelers!
- Prisoners now become hostile when entering helipad area
- added option to remove hats with button or equals key
- can't deal damage to helicopters driven by your own team
- added ammo crates to refill ammo
- new taser effects
- you can now arrest people lying down
- Added some more anti exploit stuff

Give the game a thumbs up! It lets me know you guys want updates ;D
